Array-scope defect, proposed class plural-form-not-captured. The definition declares two plurals ("—pl. רְוָוקֵי, רְוָקֵי") but the entry carries no plural_form key at all. No patch op writes entry-level arrays. Corpus-wide this is a mechanical extraction failure keyed to the plural label's rendering: 358 entries declare a plural in definition text with an empty/absent plural_form, and capture succeeds 99.6% of the time when the label is the canonical plain "Pl. " versus 28%-87% failure for every italic or lowercase rendering. Reported separately as a discovery candidate.
